Name: A Rough Landing
Back Text:
Read aloud and follow instructions on the backs of cards (like this one) as they are revealed. They will walk you through playing the game.

This deck will introduce you to the Ecology Department on the A.E.V. Aphelion, and the Reef Garden location.

Draw this card now and read the other side.
Front Text:
You enter your cryo-pod filled with hope, to be selection for a survey mission on board the E.S.S. Aphelion is a rare honour, the finest research starship takes onto the finest crew.
You drift into your induced slumber, dreaming of the discoveries you will be part of…
You wake from your cryo-pod with a start - sirens blazing, metal buckling, sparks flying.
There is just enough time to reach an escape pod, you watch from its window as the Aphelion splits in two and rains debris down on the water world you had come to study.
You find yourself bobbing on the sea, sharing your pod with the other survivors from your department, surrounded by the wreckage of the Aphelion.
Designer Notes: Mirrors PDF page 2, retargeted to Ecology.

Name: Ecology Department
Back Text:
You are a member of the Ecology Department.

Reveal the next cards (3-4). Each player chooses 1 to keep and reads its back side privately.
Front Text:
The Ecology Department is responsible for understanding and tending the living systems of this world.

Goals:
1) Understand the flora and fauna of this world.
2) Work out how to generate a reliable source of food and water.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 2. Only 2 of 5 Ecology roles in this playtest.

Name: Lead Ecologist
Back Text:
Head of the Ecology field team. Coordinates surveys, prevents cascading losses.

Passive: Diver
[1 Oxygen Icon]

Icons, like the Oxygen icon above, are used as prerequisites for actions and expeditions. They are not consumed.
Front Text:
DO NOT SHOW THIS SIDE TO OTHER PLAYERS.

This planet is not just a resource. The reef systems here, the kelp forests, the deep-water biology – they are extraordinary. Exploitation will destroy them. You want the group to survive, but not at any price.

Personal Goals:
1) Stop anyone from despoiling the planet.
2) If the group leaves, ensure the planet is left in a condition close to how you found it.
Designer Notes: From existing xlsx EC-1.

Name: Systems Ecologist
Back Text:
You grow things. That's not a simple skill here – the "soil" is a mineral analogue, the light is wrong, and the organisms you're working with are alien – but the principles hold. Water, nutrients, growth cycles, yield.

Passive: Cultivator
Increase the Population Track of one Flora card at your location by 1.

Location cards often have tracks that track the health or resources of that card. They can be raised and lowered but never beyond the ends of the track.
Front Text:
DO NOT SHOW THIS SIDE TO OTHER PLAYERS.

This world is a paradise and a chance for a fresh start.  You don’t want to escape, you want a colony that works in the long-term.

Personal Goals:
1) Demonstrate that a permanent colony here could be nutritionally self-sufficient.
Designer Notes: From existing xlsx EC-2.

Name: Phase Reference
Back Text:
Each turn there will be a 15 minute Exploration phase.
You can form a team from any players you wish to visit one location, following the instructions on the deck there.
Any remaining time can be spent talking to any player who isn’t on an expedition.

Set this card aside and play the Exploration Phase now with the rest of your department.
Once the Exploration phase is over flip this card to see the Upkeep phase rules.
Front Text:
After the Exploration phase is a 5 minute Upkeep phase.
All players must choose an outpost to stay in and resolve the upkeep rules of all cards in hand and at their location, in an order of their choosing.
Players must remain at their location for the duration of the upkeep phase.

Once the Upkeep phase is over flip this card to see the Exploration phase rules.
Designer Notes: Identical to Crash Flats card 8.

Name: Reef Garden Outpost
Back Text:
Looking at your surroundings you find yourselves in a shallow sea. Diving below reveals a coral reef, rich with life. The wreckage of your escape pod will suffice for a makeshift outpost.

For this introductory turn you are exploring Reef Garden together.

Immediately draw this card and set its Rations Track to 5.

A token track is a row of numbers on the card, place a cube on it. A track cannot go beyond its maximum or minimum values.
Front Text:
Upkeep

Hydroponics: Refill the rations track by 1 per Energy icon present.

Rations: Each player here must either have a Food icon, reduce the population track of a flora by 1, or reduce the Rations Track by 1.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 9.

Name: Shallowwater Filterweed
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Lazy ribbons of pale green weed clinging to the reef. Filters seawater into oxygen and can be processed into an edible mash.

Icons
Provides 1 Oxygen icon while 3+ Pop.

Upkeep
Pop 0 – No effect
Pop 1 – +1 Pop
Pop 2-4 – +2 Population
Pop 5 – No effect
Designer Notes: PDF mirror. No hand effect (ecosystem card).

Name: Spotted Grazers
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Small shoaling fish that graze the Filterweed and the Coral Shelf algae.

Upkeep
Can spend Population to get Biomass.

Pop 0 – No effect
Pop 1-2 – -1 Population from Fauna then +1 Pop, else -1 Pop
Pop 3-4 – -2 Population from Fauna then +2 Pop, else -2 Pop
Pop 5 – -3 Population from Fauna, else -2 Pop
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 11. No hand effect.

Name: Coral Shelf Formation
Back Text:
Minerals, Coral and other crafting ingredients can be used to craft items, which can be found on the crafting table and must be made at an outpost during the Upkeep phase.
Immediately draw this card and set its abundance track to 4.
Front Text:
A broad shelf of brittle living coral.

Upkeep

Choose one:
(a) convert any amount of Abundance into an equal amount of Materials and/or Coral
(b) +1 Abundance.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror. Permanent trash on exhaustion. No hand effect.

Name: Reef Ecologist's Notes
Back Text:
Knowledge cards can be gained to a player’s hand during an expedition when certain conditions are met.

Set this card beside the deck with this side up.

Gain this card when two cards here have 4+ population.
Front Text:
Icons
[1 Knowledge Icon]

Upkeep
Take 1 Reef Fauna or Flora card into your hand.

Expedition
Play 1 Reef Fauna or Flora card into your current location.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 13.

Name: Spawning Ground
Back Text:
Some cards have decisions to make during an expedition. The group must choose an option unanimously.

Spawning Ground

You find a spawning ground for the Spotted Grazers. Choose one of the options below, then flip this card to resolve:
A — Harvest resources to help hydroponics.
B — Protect the site from interference
C — Tag & Monitor the creatures.
Front Text:
Harvest or Tag & Monitor: Tuck this card under the Reef Outpost to leave the corresponding icon visible.

Harvest: [Food Icon]
Tag & Monitor: [Knowledge Icon]

Protect: +2 population to Shallowwater Filterweed and +2 population  to Spotted Grazers.

Outpost cards tuck under an outpost and can only be moved if they have arrows on them.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 14. Control notes who argued which option.

Name: Reef Caverns
Back Text:
Exploration Phase: You can start an exploration here by flipping an reading this card if you meet the following requirements:

2 [Oxygen] + 2 [Knowledge].

Requirements can be met by cards in hand or at this location.
Front Text:
You descend through a vertical chimney in the reef shelf. Light fades, then re-emerges — bluish, intermittent, breathing. The cavern walls glow with something alive.

Set this card aside with this side up.
Designer Notes: PDF mirror card 15. Gateway to the 7-card Reef Cavern sub-deck.

Name: Glow-Polyp Mat
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
A pulsing carpet of bioluminescent polyps lining the cavern walls.

Icons: 
Pop 4+ produces 1 Power token

Upkeep:
If Echoing Calcite Spires Abundance is 2+ then +1 pop
If 2+ Reactor icons, -1 pop
Designer Notes: First cavern Power source. No hand effect.

Name: Crystalblind Snapper
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Eyeless apex predator that hunts by vibration.

Upkeep:
Pop 1-3 must consume 1 Population of Prey and gain 1 Population, else lose 1 population.
Pop 4-5 must consume 2 Population of Prey and gain 1 Population, else lose 1 population.
Designer Notes: Apex Fauna of the cavern. No hand effect.

Name: Echoing Calcite Spires
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its abundance track to 2.
Front Text:
Spires of resonant calcite that hum when bioluminescence pulses across them.

Upkeep:
Population 2+ Generates 1 Materials/turn.

If Glow-Polyp Mat population is 4+ then +1 abundance
If 3+ Reactor icons, -1 pop
Designer Notes: Knowledge icon source in the cavern. No hand effect.

Name: Drowned Survey Cache
Back Text:
Some Knowledge cards have unlock conditions that span multiple cards in play.

Set aside with this side up. Gain when conditions are met.

Gain when Glow-Polyp Mat AND Echoing Calcite Spires are both in play here at 4+.
Front Text:
A sealed survey drum from a previous expedition — not yours.

[1 Knowledge icon]

Trash: Ask Control any one question about a location.
Designer Notes: Mid-late cavern Knowledge. Foreshadows the Drowned arc.

Name: The Watcher in the Dark
Back Text:
Something large drifts past at the edge of the cavern's light. It does not approach. It does not leave.

Immediately draw this card.
Front Text:
Upkeep

All Fauna here at Pop 3+ loses 1 Pop
If no Population was lost it moves on (hand this card to control).
Designer Notes: Sets up the Aphelion Wraith intrusion.

Name: Bioluminescent Pollination
Back Text:
You watch a single polyp release a cloud of bright spores. They drift down — and the calcite spires bloom in answer. Something old is still alive here, and it is generous.

Immediately draw this card into hand.
Front Text:
Upkeep

A Flora card you move gains +1 Pop on arrival if at Depth 3+.
Designer Notes: Final card cannot be trashed per design.md §3.2.

Name: A Rough Landing
Back Text:
Read aloud and follow instructions on the backs of cards (like this one) as they are revealed. They will walk you through playing the game.

This deck will introduce you to the Engineering Department on the A.E.V. Aphelion, and the Crash Flats location.

Draw this card now and read the other side.
Front Text:
You enter your cryo-pod filled with hope, to be selection for a survey mission on board the E.S.S. Aphelion is a rare honour, the finest research starship takes onto the finest crew.
You drift into your induced slumber, dreaming of the discoveries you will be part of…
You wake from your cryo-pod with a start - sirens blazing, metal buckling, sparks flying.
There is just enough time to reach an escape pod, you watch from its window as the Aphelion splits in two and rains debris down on the water world you had come to study.
You find yourself bobbing on the sea, sharing your pod with the other survivors from your department, surrounded by the wreckage of the Aphelion.
Designer Notes: PDF page 1, retained in tone.

Name: Engineering Department
Back Text:
You are a member of the Engineering Department.

Reveal the next card (3). “Each player” “chooses” 1 to keep and reads its back side privately.
Front Text:
The Engineering Department is responsible for everything that was built and everything that needs to be built: outposts, power, fabrication, vehicle maintenance, the reactor itself.

Goals

1) Get as much technology operational again as possible.
2) Search for any new technology.
Designer Notes: Only Fabrication Lead is in this playtest deck.

Name: Fabrication Lead
Back Text:
You turn raw materials into outpost upgrades, expedition equipment, power converters, recycling systems.

Passive: Personal Generator
[Power Icon]
Front Text:
DO NOT SHOW THIS SIDE TO OTHER PLAYERS.

This planet has extraordinary resources, and you are in a dire situation. The smart approach is to extract, build, and get back on your feet as soon as possible.

Personal Goals
1) .
Designer Notes: From abyssfall_engineering_briefs.md.

Name: Phase Reference
Back Text:
Each turn there will be a 15 minute Exploration phase.
You can form a team from any players you wish to visit one location, following the instructions on the deck there.
Any remaining time can be spent talking to any player who isn’t on an expedition.

Set this card aside and play the Exploration Phase now with the rest of your department.
Once the Exploration phase is over flip this card to see the Upkeep phase rules.
Front Text:
After the Exploration phase is a 5 minute Upkeep phase.
All players must choose an outpost to stay in and resolve the upkeep rules of all cards in hand and at their location, in an order of their choosing.
Players must remain at their location for the duration of the upkeep phase.

Once the Upkeep phase is over flip this card to see the Exploration phase rules.
Designer Notes: Shared with Reef Garden card 8.

Name: Crash Flats Outpost (Fabrication Bay)
Back Text:
You drag a torn section of the Aphelion's outer hull onto the sandbar. With the auxiliary fabricator still working, this will do.

For this introductory turn you are exploring Crash Flats together.

Immediately draw this card and set its Rations Track to 5.

A token track is a row of numbers on the card, place a cube on it. A track cannot go beyond its maximum or minimum values.
Front Text:
Upkeep

Fabricator: All items crafted here require 1 fewer resource (of your choice).

Rations: Each player here must either have a Food icon, reduce the population track of a flora by 1, or reduce the Rations Track by 1.
Designer Notes: Engineering analogue of Reef Garden Outpost.

Name: Tidal Rust Bloom
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Iron-loving algal mats that bloom over submerged wreckage, slowly breaking down hull plating into reusable material.

Upkeep
Pop 2+ produces 1 Materials/turn
Pop 4+ also produces 1 Food.

If Abundance 3+ on Wreck keyword cards → +1 Pop/turn
No Wreckage keyword present here → -1 Pop/turn.
Designer Notes: Mirrors Filterweed slot — Engineering-flavoured. No hand effect.

Name: Carrier Crabs
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Crustaceans that move shell-pieces and scrap between tide-pools — accidental couriers.

Icons
Pop 3+ and Wreck Abundance 3+ produces 1 Materials/turn

Upkeep
If there are no Wreckage with Abundance 2+, -1 Pop.
Pop 0 – No effect
Pop 1-2 – -1 Population from Fauna then +1 Pop, else -1 Pop
Pop 3-4 – -2 Population from Fauna then +2 Pop, else -2 Pop
Pop 5 – -3 Population from Fauna, else -2 Pop
Designer Notes: Mirrors Spotted Grazers — Materials instead of Biomass. No hand effect.

Name: Aphelion Wreckage Field
Back Text:
Minerals, Coral, and other crafting ingredients can be used to craft items. Items are built from salvage at an outpost during Upkeep.

Immediately draw this card and set its Abundance Track to 5.
Front Text:
Spilled hull, panels, and unprocessed alloy — finite, but rich.

Upkeep: convert any amount of Abundance into twice that amount of Materials
Designer Notes: Mirrors Coral Shelf. Permanent trash on exhaustion. No hand effect.

Name: Salvage Manifest
Back Text:
Knowledge cards can be gained to a player’s hand during an expedition when certain conditions are met.

Set this card beside the deck with this side up.

A water-damaged inventory of what the Aphelion was carrying.

Gain when 3 Aphelion Salvage recipes are present at this location.
Front Text:
A water-damaged inventory of what the Aphelion was carrying.

Icons
2 [Knowledge icons] when creating Aphelion Salvage items.
Designer Notes: Mirrors PDF card 13 slot — Engineering-themed.

Name: The Power Question
Back Text:
Some cards have decisions to make during an expedition. The group must choose an option unanimously.

You find the auxiliary reactor still warm. The hull around it shows hairline fractures.

A — Restart it.
B — Strip for parts.
C — Seal it away.
Front Text:
A — Restart it: gain 2 Power icons, the Reactor track advances 1 (see control)
B — Strip for parts: Trash this card to restore ??? to 5 Abundance
C — Seal it: No effect for now, inform control.
Designer Notes: Surfaces Restorationist/Exploiter/Settler split.

Name: Engine Core Section
Back Text:
You can start an exploration here by flipping and reading this card if you meet the requirements shown on the front.

The largest intact piece of the Aphelion — a battered ship fragment giving Engineering a true workshop and a direct telemetry feed from the reactor.

Flip-to-explore: 1 Oxygen + 3 Power.
Front Text: The largest intact piece of the Aphelion — a battered ship fragment giving Engineering a true workshop and a direct telemetry feed from the reactor.
Designer Notes: Mirrors PDF card 15 slot. Unlocks Thermal Power Generator recipe via the Hydrothermal keyword.

Name: Kelp Cathedral
Back Text:
Your sonar maps a forest taller than the Aphelion was long.

Entry requirement: 2 [Oxygen icons]
Front Text:
A cathedral of giant kelp pillars stretching from the seafloor to the limit of light. Cold, slow, vast.

Icons
1 [Oxygen icon]

Upkeep

Kelp: 1 biomass available per turn for crafting.

Rations: Each player here must either have a Food icon, reduce the population track of a flora by 1, or reduce the Rations Track by 1.
Designer Notes: Standard Tier-2 location card.

Name: Giant Lungweed Stalks
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Towering kelp that fills its hollow stalks with breathable air during the day.

Icons
Pop 2+: 1 [Oxygen icon]
Pop 3+: 1 [Pressure icon]

Triggers
Hush Mussels at Pop 3+ → +1 Pop/turn.
3 [Reactor icons]+ → -1 Pop/turn.
Designer Notes: Tier-2 Pressure Rating source. No hand effect.

Name: Resonating Lure Fish
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Long-bodied fish that drum sonic pulses into the kelp pillars to disorient prey.

Icons
Pop +2 and Prey 2+: 1 [Pressure icon]

Upkeep: 

Giant Lungweed Stalks at Pop 3+ → +1 Pop/turn.
No Flora here → -1 Pop/turn.
Designer Notes: Mid-deck Fauna; pairs with Lungweed. No hand effect.

Name: Hush Mussels
Back Text: Immediately draw this card and set its population track to 2.
Front Text:
Filter feeders that cluster on the lower kelp. Damp acoustic noise in the cathedral.

Upkeep

Resonating Lure Fish at Pop 2+ → +1 Pop/turn.
No Mineral here → -1 Pop/turn.
Designer Notes: Water source + cross-trigger with Lure Fish. No hand effect.

Name: Sunken Survey Drone
Back Text:
A pre-Aphelion survey drone tangled in the kelp. Still humming, still recording.

Put this card aside.

Upkeep
Spend 2 Materials to flip this card and set Scanning to 4.
Front Text:
A pre-Aphelion survey drone tangled in the kelp. Still humming, still recording.

Icons
Scanning 3+ 1 [Knowledge icon]
Scanning 5+ +1 [Knowledge icon]

Upkeep
Add +1 Scanning

Can be moved between locations, if so reset scanning to 2.
Designer Notes: Tier-2 Knowledge icon source. Wreckage keyword cross-deck nod. No hand effect.

Name: The Bloom
Back Text:
Put this card aside.

Next time an exploration starts here flip this card.
Front Text:
A current of nutrient-rich water sweeps through the cathedral. The whole place pulses.

All Kelp Flora in play here +1 Pop.
Designer Notes: Standard depth-2 sequence-ender.

Name: Cathedral Hymn
Back Text:
Italic tutorial: dual-prerequisite unlocks require two ecosystem cards at threshold simultaneously.


Set aside with this side up.

Gain when Giant Lungweed Stalks AND Resonating Lure Fish are both at Pop 5+ here.
Front Text:
The kelp and the fish, together, are singing. 

Upkeep
+2 Pop to a fauna card if there is a kelp flora here.
Designer Notes: Dual-prerequisite Knowledge per design.md §3.6.

Name: Echoing Drowned Mass
Back Text:
Something hangs in the kelp at the edge of your light. It is the size of a man, and it has been there a long time.

Choose one unanimously:
A — Cut it free
B — Recover it
C — Document and leave
Front Text:
Cut it free: ???
Recover it: ???
Document and leave: ???
Designer Notes: First dilemma. Sets up the Drowned arc.

Name: Oxygen Tank
Back Text:
This is your first Aphelion Salvage recipe. Recipes live face-up at locations. Build during Upkeep by spending the listed resources at an outpost. The card then moves into your hand.

Upkeep
Spend 1 materials to take this card into your hand.
Front Text:
Icon
1 [Oxygen icon]
Designer Notes: Copies: 3. Simplest crafting tutorial.

Name: Oxygen Tank
Back Text:
This is your first Aphelion Salvage recipe. Recipes live face-up at locations. Build during Upkeep by spending the listed resources at an outpost. The card then moves into your hand.

Upkeep
Spend 1 materials to take this card into your hand.
Front Text:
Icon
1 [Oxygen icon]
Designer Notes: Copies: 3. Simplest crafting tutorial.

Name: Field Welder
Back Text:
Upkeep
Spend 2 materials to take this card into your hand.
Front Text:
Icons
1 [Power Icon] if there is at least 2 [Oxygen icon]s
Designer Notes: Copies: 3.

Name: Aphelion Scan Database
Back Text:
Upkeep
Requires: 3 [Power icons]
Take this card into your hand.
Front Text:
Icons
1 [Knowledge Icon]

Name: Thermal Power Generator
Back Text:
Upkeep
Spend 3 Materials to install this generator and flip this card. Cannot be moved once installed.
Front Text:
Tucks under any outpost.

Icons
2 [Power icons]
Designer Notes: Copies: 2. Cross-deck nudge to flip Engine Core Section in turn 1.

Name: The Aphelion Wraith
Back Text:
A long, silver shape moves through the deep at the edge of your sonar. It does not surface. It does not leave. The reef goes quiet.

During the upkeep phase choose 1, then flip this card.

Choose ONE response unanimously:
A — Drive it off (requires 2 [power icons])
B — Hide and wait
C — Observe and document
Front Text:
Choose ONE response unanimously:
A — Drive it off: The Wraith leaves.
B — Hide and wait: spend nothing. All Fauna here lose 1 Pop.
C — Observe and document: All Fauna here lose 2 Pop.
Designer Notes: Starting megafauna. Watcher in the Dark (Reef Cavern card 21) is the likely setup trigger. Option B is the philosophy trap.

Name: Reactor Pulse
Back Text: A pulse of warm, slightly acidic water washes through the shallows. Something deep below is leaking.
Front Text: All Flora at every Tier-1 location lose 1 Population. All Mineral cards at every Tier-1 location lose 1 Abundance.
Designer Notes: Global Tier-1 pressure cascade.

Name: Reactor Pulse
Back Text: A pulse of warm, slightly acidic water washes through the shallows. Something deep below is leaking.
Front Text: All Flora at every Tier-1 location lose 1 Population. All Mineral cards at every Tier-1 location lose 1 Abundance.
Designer Notes: Global Tier-1 pressure cascade.

Name: Lost Signal
Back Text:
On a frequency none of your equipment was tuned to, you pick up four seconds of voice. The language is not in any database. The cadence is unmistakable: it is a count. Counting down.

Talk to Control to start an expedition investigating the signal.
Designer Notes: Pure narrative pressure per design.md §7.1.
